# LSD reference fixtures

The files in `simple_testdict1/` are copied from the test data of
[nongeneric/lsd2dsl](https://github.com/nongeneric/lsd2dsl), commit `0b8555c`
(2024-01-17), under its MIT license. The upstream license text is preserved in
`MIT-LICENSE.txt`.

They are kept here so all LSD-specific code and fixture data live under
`internal/format/lsd/` and can be removed together if needed. The set includes
the expected DSL and annotation output, tiny dictionaries for versions 12,
X3 and X5, overlay images, and tests of headings, extended titles and variant
collapsing. It does not establish compatibility with every real-world LSD
dictionary or Lingvo version.

These are test inputs only. Do not use them as application content or as
evidence that all decoded dictionary material may be redistributed.
